data.title: bn-26wt: block FF-absorb path-prefix collisions
data.description: Fresh-eyes review found FF-absorb exact-path overlap checks missed directory/file prefix collisions. The fix makes all safety gates component-aware and adds unit plus full CLI symlink-containment regressions. just check passes.

data.body: LOW: Security-positive. paths_conflict closes a workspace-containment escape: the prior exact-path intersection missed directory/file prefix collisions, so a dirty ancestor symlink (shape -> /outside) with stale descendant shape/file.txt passed the FF-absorb gate and materialization wrote through the symlink, outside the workspace. Component-wise Path::starts_with correctly rejects shape vs shapely, and the check is applied in all three gates. CLI regression verifies no write escapes to outside/. No new attack surface.

data.reason: Security fix verified: closes symlink-write containment escape; component-aware paths_conflict applied in all three FF-absorb gates; CLI regression proves no write escapes the workspace. No new attack surface.
